name: Deep Shrestha
profileSummary: Deep Shrestha is a Nepalese singer and musician. Deep Shrestha is one of the coaches in The Voice of Nepal Season 1 (2018) and 2 (2019) and Season 3.He is also judge in Mero Voice Universe season 1. "Jhaskiyecha Maan Mero", "Biteka Kura Le" and "Ma Ta Door Dekhi Aye" are among his popular songs.
